comment: Curated view of the built-in categories for the policy generator's Autodesk products panel. Every category id and knob value name must exist in settings.json (tests/site check it). Knobs are only settings the category's shipped rule actually uses (src/engine/DeadLoad/Data/Defaults.psd1): no routine age where RoutineAction is None. Reasons and warnings are taken from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 7 and its decision record, written in plain words: user-facing strings must not cite internal decision or requirement ids (a test checks).

excluded.reason: Custom targets are a list policy (one registry value per target) and are not in the settings catalog; set them in the Group Policy editor.

knobs.label: Compress journals older than
knobs.help: Journals are compressed into monthly zip archives beside them; each entry is verified before the original is deleted.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, keep the newest
knobs.help: Journals are deleted only when free space is below the pressure floor, and these newest ones are always kept.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, delete only journals older than
knobs.help: Applies only below the pressure floor.

categories.offWarning: Off: journals are no longer compressed or archived by DeadLoad. Revit's own journal cleanup still applies.

knobs.label: Delete archives older than
knobs.help: Archives are the monthly zip files DeadLoad writes from compressed journals.

knobs.label: Always keep the newest
knobs.help: Kept by every rule, including under disk pressure.

knobs.label: Raise Revit's journal shelf life to at least
knobs.help: Revit.ini [Backups] JournalShelfLife. Revit itself deletes older journals once it holds more than its count; this keeps them long enough for DeadLoad to compress them.

knobs.label: Raise Revit's journal count to at least
knobs.help: Revit.ini [Backups] JournalShelfCapacity. The shipped value keeps Revit's own default of 10.

categories.offWarning: Off: Revit's own cleanup keeps its defaults (more than 10 journals: those older than 10 days are deleted), which can delete journals before DeadLoad's weekly run compresses them.

knobs.label: Delete cache files older than
knobs.help: Age is the newest of created, modified and accessed.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, delete cache files older than
knobs.help: Applies only below the pressure floor.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, delete content older than
knobs.help: There is no routine rule: Revit manages the size of this cache itself. Its Logs folder and .json files are always kept.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, remove project caches not used for
knobs.help: The collaboration cache is only ever removed under disk pressure, one project folder at a time.

knobs.label: Never remove a project cache used in the last
knobs.help: 2160 hours is 90 days. Both limits apply: a project cache must pass both.

categories.offReason: Off by default: Autodesk documents that clearing the collaboration cache destroys changes that were saved but not yet synchronized.
categories.onWarning: Removing a model's collaboration cache can lose changes that were saved but not synchronized. Ask users to synchronize with central first. Restricted: users never see it in their review; only the scheduled runs remove it, under disk pressure, while the user does not run Revit.

knobs.label: Delete a version's folder when nothing in it changed for
knobs.help: Only folders of Revit years that are not installed. The collaboration cache inside is excluded.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, when nothing in it changed for
knobs.help: Applies only below the pressure floor.

categories.offReason: Off by default: the measured folders hold only journals, crash dumps and model backups. Revit journals are already kept as records, and deleting a whole version folder is a records decision for the owner.
categories.onWarning: Deletes the whole folder of a Revit version that is no longer installed, including its journals and model backups. Restricted: only the scheduled runs act on it.

knobs.label: Delete cache files older than
knobs.help: Age is the newest of created, modified and accessed.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, delete cache files older than
knobs.help: Applies only below the pressure floor.

categories.offReason: Off by default: measured at most 34 MB per user and year, too small to justify a default rule.
categories.onWarning: AutoCAD rebuilds the cache, so drawings may open slower the next time.

knobs.label: Delete automatic save files older than
knobs.help: Age is the modified time.

knobs.label: Never delete files newer than
knobs.help: Recent automatic saves are always kept.

categories.offReason: Off by default: automatic save files can recover a drawing after AutoCAD closes unexpectedly, and on the measured workstations none or only empty ones were found.
categories.onWarning: A deleted automatic save file can no longer recover a drawing. Restricted: never part of a user-started cleanup; only the scheduled runs act on it.

knobs.label: Delete error logs and dumps older than
knobs.help: Age is the modified time.

categories.offReason: Off by default: documented by Autodesk, but none were found on the measured workstations, and Windows already caps the CrashDumps folder at 10 dumps.

knobs.label: Delete crash reports older than
knobs.help: Each item is one crash-signature folder, judged by the newest file in it.

knobs.label: Always keep the newest
knobs.help: Kept by every rule, including under disk pressure.

knobs.label: Delete installer logs older than
knobs.help: Age is the modified time. The install history (IHT) folder is left to the Autodesk installer.

knobs.label: Always keep the newest
knobs.help: Kept by every rule, including under disk pressure.

knobs.label: Under disk pressure, remove installer folders not used for
knobs.help: There is no routine rule: installer folders are only removed under disk pressure.

knobs.label: Never remove a folder used in the last
knobs.help: 2160 hours is 90 days. Both limits apply.

categories.offReason: Off by default: Autodesk says the extracted installation files can be deleted after installation but recommends keeping them; updates, repairs and reinstalls may need them.
categories.onWarning: Removed only under disk pressure, never Network License Manager and never a folder an installed product names as its install source. An update or repair may then need the installation media again.

knobs.label: Delete files older than
knobs.help: Age is the newest of created, modified and accessed. Files of a Revit or AutoCAD session that is still running are kept.

knobs.label: Never touch files newer than
knobs.help: Applies to every rule, including under disk pressure.

knobs.label: Delete files older than
knobs.help: Age is the newest of created, modified and accessed.

knobs.label: Never touch files newer than
knobs.help: Applies to every rule, including under disk pressure.
